purpose: Challenge the top three public-only candidate decisions with third-party or ecosystem evidence without upgrading any claim into demand, permission or willingness to pay.

independentEvidence.claim: Yelp's public 2023 Advertising Partner Awards names Leadhub as the Best in Lead Generation winner.

candidates.hostileChallenge: The award strengthens capability credibility but does not show that Leadhub wants a new vendor, would white-label an evidence sprint or would pay for it. Direct overlap remains the key kill risk.

independentEvidence.claim: FieldEdge publicly presents BxB Media as a partner and describes its work with HVAC, plumbing and electrical professionals.
supports: ecosystem partnership is a normal motion

candidates.hostileChallenge: An ecosystem partner page confirms adjacency, not receptivity. BxB's own direct marketing footprint may make an independent evidence offer redundant unless the buyer-visible value is clearly distinct.

independentEvidence.claim: CI Web Group publicly describes Lemon Seed Marketing as a strategic partner, says the relationship began in 2017 and describes joint work serving trades businesses.
supports: partnership motion is publicly normal in this ecosystem

candidates.hostileChallenge: The partnership is strong evidence that ecosystem collaboration happens, but it also surfaces a possible incumbent/technology-partner conflict. Any future offer must prove incremental value rather than generic marketing help.

crossCandidateDecision.nextSafeStep: Owner review of a non-contact research brief, followed by a separate authority decision. Do not infer permission from partner status or platform recognition.
crossCandidateDecision.commercialConclusion: The top three remain research-qualified targets, not leads, prospects in an outbound queue or customers.
